nodes.label: Loki binary
nodes.desc: main (L44) parses ConfigWrapper, calls loki.New (L138) then t.Run (L149)

nodes.label: Loki root struct
nodes.desc: Loki struct (L446) aggregates Server, Distributor, Ingester, Querier, Store; serves /ready (L638)

nodes.label: Module manager
nodes.desc: Module names Distributor (L114) and Querier (L123); initDistributor (L341) wires the push HTTP handler (L393)

nodes.label: Push HTTP handler
nodes.desc: PushHandler (L32) serves POST /loki/api/v1/push with auth middleware

nodes.label: OTLP push handler
nodes.desc: OTLPPushHandler (L36) accepts OpenTelemetry /otlp/v1/logs payloads

nodes.label: Request decoder
nodes.desc: ParseLokiRequest (L278) decompresses and unmarshals push bodies, caps labels at 16MB (L58)

nodes.label: Distributor
nodes.desc: Distributor struct (L188), constructor New (L248); rate limits and validation per tenant

nodes.label: Push flow
nodes.desc: pushWithResolver (L520) validates streams, shards them by label hash, and replicates to ingesters

nodes.label: Ingester service
nodes.desc: Ingester (L242) created by New (L318); Push (L1018) dispatches per tenant and throttles on full WAL disk

nodes.label: Tenant instance
nodes.desc: instance (L110); Push (L231) loads or creates streams then appends entries

nodes.label: Stream creation
nodes.desc: createStream (L283) parses labels, resolves policies and enforces stream-count limits

nodes.label: Stream buffer
nodes.desc: stream (L45); Push (L168) appends entries into compressed chunk descriptions

nodes.label: Chunk cut
nodes.desc: cutChunk (L492) closes a full chunk so the flusher can ship it to object storage

nodes.label: Write-ahead log
nodes.desc: WAL interface (L63); records survive restarts before chunks are flushed

nodes.label: Querier API wiring
nodes.desc: initQuerier (L520) builds querier.NewQuerierAPI (L642) and the LogQL engine via logql.NewEngine (L2298)

nodes.label: LogQL parser
nodes.desc: ParseExpr (L62), ParseLogSelector (L265), ParseLabels (L296) turn query strings into ASTs

nodes.label: QueryEngine
nodes.desc: QueryEngine (L208) built by NewEngine (L216); Query (L230) returns an executable query

nodes.label: Query execution
nodes.desc: query.Exec (L273) instruments the run then defers to Eval (L314)

nodes.label: Evaluator
nodes.desc: EvaluatorFactory (L273); NewDefaultEvaluator (L310) pulls iterators and evaluates stages over time ranges

nodes.label: Single-tenant querier
nodes.desc: SingleTenantQuerier (L165), constructor New (L186) takes chunkStore plus dataObjStore; SelectLogs (L217)

nodes.label: Sample selection
nodes.desc: SelectSamples (L290) serves metric queries like rate({job="x"} |= "err" | count)

nodes.label: Ingester querier
nodes.desc: IngesterQuerier (L50), NewIngesterQuerier (L59) reads still-buffered logs straight from ingesters

nodes.label: LokiStore
nodes.desc: LokiStore (L99); NewStore (L132) builds per-period index and chunk clients from schema config

nodes.label: Store reads
nodes.desc: SelectLogs (L531) and SelectSamples (L579) fan out over schema periods and days

nodes.label: Chunk client
nodes.desc: NewChunkClient (L354) instantiates the object backend chosen per schema period

nodes.label: Object client
nodes.desc: NewObjectClient (L415) returns S3/GCS/Azure/filesystem clients holding compressed chunks

nodes.label: TSDB index builder
nodes.desc: Builds single-store TSDB index files: only labels and stream bounds are indexed, never line text

nodes.label: Data object format
nodes.desc: Object (L89) is the new columnar object format; builders upload dataobjs and a metastore tracks them

nodes.label: Ruler
nodes.desc: NewRuler (L14) wraps the ruler base to evaluate alerting and recording rules

nodes.label: Ruler query engine
nodes.desc: createRulerQueryEngine reuses the same QueryEngine (L1548) so rules speak LogQL too
